notes: No classification accuracy is reported for any model; Table 2 (p. 8) only has counterfactual-quality metrics, each a mean over Neval=10 randomly selected class-0 test queries per dataset: L1 / L2 = Manhattan / Euclidean distance between factual and counterfactual in the MinMax-scaled feature space (lower is better); Confidence = classifier's predicted probability of the target class at the counterfactual (PTM: 100 MC clause samples for final evaluation, 50 during BO); Robustness = fraction of 50 Gaussian-perturbed copies (sigma=0.01) that keep the target-class prediction; Success Rate (100% for all methods, text only, Sec. 7.2). PTM+BO = multi-objective Optuna TPE BO minimising (|p(x')-tau|, ||x'-x||_2), eps=0.1, 300 trials, 10 repeats per query (seeds 42..51); targets tau=0.50 and 0.85 are pre-set. Baselines run on a different classifier (ANN), so they are not like-for-like. TM config: C=20 clauses, but Appendix B describes a binary TM with m clauses split into m/2 positive and m/2 negative, and the paper never says whether C counts per class or in total, so clauses_scope is not_reported. 'Automaton states S=100' does not say whether it is N or 2N (Appendix B uses 2N states per TA), so n_states is not_reported. Epochs are given only as the range '50-80' with no per-dataset mapping, so epochs is not_reported. MinMax scaling is stated for the real-world datasets (before splitting, i.e. fitted on all data); for the synthetic sets only the metric space is called MinMax-scaled. Whether the quantile thresholds were computed on train only is not stated. Internal inconsistency: Appendix C (p. 17) says PTM+BO (tau=0.50) on Iris has L2 = 0.28, while Table 2 prints 0.366 +/- 0.046; the record follows Table 2. The ANN baselines use early stopping, but the data used for it is not stated. Robustness 1.000 entries in Table 2 carry no std.
